_meta.purpose: Curated discriminating-domain map for mamey reclass-check (lead L1). This is the 'shippable map' the IDEA_BUNDLE_EVALUATED.md requires before reclass-check ships — the prototype's naive map deliberately exposed false positives (betalactone via generic AMP-binding/Abhydrolase; terpene via domains absent from sec_met_domains).
_meta.provenance: Domain sets are the DISCRIMINATING (class-specific) core biosynthetic domains from antiSMASH cluster-definition rules, cross-checked against empirically observed sec_met_domains in a real v9.7.202 sealed cohort package (ids withheld, v9.7.372). Generic/ubiquitous domains (AMP-binding, Abhydrolase, Condensation, PCP, adh_short, NRPS-A_a2, MarR, GerE) are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED — they co-occur across many classes and drove the prototype's false positives.
usage_rules: A class is 'domain-supported' only if >=min_domains of its discriminating domains are present.
Classes flagged require_specific=true must NOT be inferred from generic domains — only the listed specific ones count.

Classes with in_sec_met_domains=false (terpene, ectoine, saccharide) are NOT detectable from the per-gene sec_met_domains column; reclass-check must SKIP the 'label lacks domain' check for these to avoid the terpene false-positive, and instead defer to the antiSMASH product label as authoritative.
single_strain_unreliable=true classes had n=1 in the derivation strain; their empirical domain sets are noise — use only the canonical listed domains, never auto-derive from one strain.
_meta.verified_on: a cohort strain, v9.7.202 engine 1.9.109; false-positive classes (betalactone, terpene-label-lacks) confirmed and suppressed
false_positive_suppression: betalactone: REMOVED as an inferable class — its antiSMASH rule (AMP-binding + Abhydrolase) is non-discriminating; only trust the explicit antiSMASH label, never infer.

terpene / terpene-precursor / ectoine / saccharide / oligosaccharide: in_sec_met_domains=false — the diagnostic terpene-cyclase / ectoine / sugar domains are not surfaced in sec_met_domains, so 'label lacks domain' would false-fire. SKIP domain-check for these.
_meta.tokenization_caveat: CRITICAL for patch chat: the per-gene sec_met_domains column uses different domain tokens than antiSMASH's region-classification rules (e.g. class-iii lanthipeptide enzyme tagged 'Pkinase' not 'micKC'; NRPS adenylation tagged 'NRPS-A_a2' not always 'Condensation'). The label_unsupported check is therefore UNRELIABLE for classes whose region-rule marker gets re-tokenized per-gene. Restricted to PKS/siderophore/thiopeptide where markers appear reliably. This is a genuine data-surface finding, not a map bug.

NRPS.note: Requires >=2 NRPS-A_a*/Condensation domains — a single adenylation domain is a tailoring/loading module in PKS/terpene clusters, not an undeclared NRPS pathway. Verified: drops BGC029/020/004/036 single-domain FPs.

T1PKS.note: Verified: 7/7 T1PKS BGCs in the verification strain carry PKS_AT + PKSI-KS_m3 + Acyl_transf_1.

T2PKS.note: PKSI-KS_m4 REMOVED — co-occurs in T1PKS, drove FPs on BGC009/018/020/029. Require 2 T2-specific.

T3PKS.min_domains_rationale: Both Chal_sti_synt_N and Chal_sti_synt_C are required. A genuine type III PKS carries the paired N- and C-terminal profiles; the thiolase-superfamily fold shared with HMG-CoA synthase fires only the N-terminal profile. Cohort measurement 2026-08-26 over 1575 region GBKs / 39 strains: 55 CDS carry a Chal_sti_synt profile - 31 paired, 18 N-only, 6 C-only, and all 18 N-only sit in regions that call T3PKS. Verified case AS-XXX / NODE_48_length_47999_cov_32.892179 / region001 / BGC028 gene ctg48_4: N-only at E=2e-11 bitscore 35.3, read as HMG-CoA synthase by Swiss-Prot, NCBI nr, smCOG and MIBiG independently. reclass_check is OPERATOR_ONLY: a review prompt, never a reclassification verdict.

lanthipeptide-class-i.note: Verified: 2/2 class-i BGCs carry the full LanB(split)+LanC set.

lanthipeptide-class-iii.note: micKC is the class-iii-specific kinase/cyclase (BGC039 ctg9_41).

lanthipeptide-class-iv.note: LANC_like/Pkinase shared across lanthipeptide classes — cannot discriminate iv from i/iii on domains alone. Trust antiSMASH label. Set unreachable min to suppress FP.

thiopeptide.note: Thiopeptide_F_RRE + TIGR03882 (docking protein) distinguish thiopeptide from generic azole-RiPP. This is the BGC013/BGC011/BGC038/BGC026 undersell signal.

azole-containing-RiPP.note: YcaO/TIGR03604 = azoline cyclodehydratase. If Thiopeptide_F_RRE ALSO present, upgrade to thiopeptide.

NI-siderophore.note: Verified: 3/3 NI-siderophore BGCs carry IucA_IucC + FhuF (8% overall — strongly discriminating).

NRP-metallophore.note: MbtH is the metallophore-discriminating marker; the NRPS backbone domains alone are non-discriminating. This fixes the prototype's 'NRP-metallophore label lacks diagnostic domain' flag (which was reading only backbone domains).

ranthipeptide.note: Per BGCFlow mycofactocin case: ranthipeptide + TIGR03997 (ARTS core model) may actually be mycofactocin — see motif library IDGMCGVY check.

skip_domain_check._comment: These classes have diagnostic machinery NOT surfaced in sec_met_domains. reclass-check must trust the antiSMASH label for these and NOT flag 'label lacks domain'. This suppresses the terpene/ectoine false-positive family confirmed on AS-XXX.
